Options:
opa. Fluoroquinolones have a smaller spectrum of activity than first-generation quinolones.
opb. The second generation quinolones are very effective against anaerobes.
opc. Fluoroquinolones are not effective against enterobacteria.
opd. Fluoroquinolones are effective against Gram-positive but less than Gram-negative.
ope. The third and fourth generation fluoroquinolones are not effective against streptococci or staphylococci.
